title: Community Food Drive
description: Join us as we pack and distribute meal boxes for families in our neighborhood. All ages welcome — bring a friend and a box of canned goods if you can.

title: Young Adults Bonfire Night
description: An evening of worship, s'mores, and honest conversation for ages 18-30. Bring a chair if you have one.

title: Marriage Enrichment Workshop
description: A half-day workshop for couples at any stage of marriage, led by Pastor James and Naomi Cole. Childcare provided.

title: Baptism Sunday
description: Celebrate with those taking their next step in faith. If you're considering baptism, speak to any usher after service.

title: Kids Club Fall Kickoff
description: A new season of Kids Club begins with games, worship, and a Bible adventure series for ages 4-11.
